title: Dan Burisch and J-Rod at S4

tellings.quote: Microbiologist out at S4 who interfaced with the J rod, a recovered living extraterrestrial entity that was housed at uh seven six layers under Area 51 S4

plain: A microbiologist named Dan Burisch is said to have worked at S4, a site tied to Area 51, the secret military base in the Nevada desert. There, around 2003 and 2004, he is said to have dealt with "J-Rod", a living extraterrestrial that had been recovered and was kept six or seven levels underground. The guest known online as UAPGerb passes this on as what Burisch has said, and if it were true it would mean the US government held a live alien being.
